//: mesh-dispatcher config — the SSE driver. Copy to ~/bin/mesh-agents.json.
//basic_auth: Optional 'user:pass' if your Mesh sits behind an HTTP basic-auth reverse proxy. Sent only to the mesh_api_url host; the app auth uses X-Agent-Key, so they never collide. Null = none.
//agents: Agents on the DISPATCHER path (spawned per-task by SSE, model chosen at spawn). Typically your coordinator/orchestrator. env_file = per-agent GitHub identity + secrets injected at spawn.
